description.value: Guangzhou Garden is an authentic Chinese restaurant in Duncan, BC, serving traditional dishes including dim sum, dumplings, and wonton soup prepared without MSG. The dining room seats up to 125 people, making it a practical stop for cycling clubs or larger tour groups passing through the Cowichan Valley. A weekly lunch and dinner buffet runs Tuesday through Sunday alongside regular dine-in, takeout, and delivery options.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fetched successfully and confirms an active Chinese restaurant at 2721 James Street, Duncan, BC V9L 2Y1, matching the OSM address; the OSM phone number (+12507481288 = 250-748-1288) is one of two numbers listed on the website, confirming it. Takeout is explicitly stated on the website ('Delivery, Dine-in & Takeout available every day'); no bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site. Two notable concerns: OSM uses 'Guangzhou Garden' (singular) while the website consistently uses 'Guangzhou Gardens' (plural), and one menu subpage title reads 'Mr. Ping's Noodles' — likely a stale Wix template artifact rather than a different business.
